ISTJ.want: The satisfaction of seeing things through, and the security of being trusted
ISTJ.effort: Following rules and steps, and building up without mistakes
ISTJ.work: Work with clear rules and steps, where accuracy is valued

ISFJ.want: Feeling useful to others, and a place where you feel safe
ISFJ.effort: Thinking ahead, paying attention, and supporting those around you
ISFJ.work: Work where you support people close to you and get thanked directly

INFJ.want: A sense of being part of something meaningful, and relationships where you truly understand each other
INFJ.effort: Reading people's feelings and picking up on what goes unsaid
INFJ.work: Work where you can be part of people's growth and inner lives for the long run

INTJ.want: The satisfaction of moving things with a plan you made, and time alone to think deeply
INTJ.effort: Looking ahead, laying out the logic, and showing the shortest route
INTJ.work: Work where you're trusted with long-term strategy and building systems

ISTP.want: The freedom to solve problems with your own hands and head, and time without interference
ISTP.effort: Fixing problems calmly and quickly when they come up
ISTP.work: Work where the results of your hands-on effort are plain to see

ISFP.want: Being honest about what you love, and calm relationships
ISFP.effort: Keeping the peace and softening the mood with your own sense of things
ISFP.work: Work where you can use your sensitivity and go at your own pace

INFP.want: Being able to honor your values, and a purpose you truly care about
INFP.effort: Staying close to people's feelings and putting ideals into words or form
INFP.work: Work where you can express what you believe in

INTP.want: The freedom to think things through as deeply as you like, and intellectual stimulation
INTP.effort: Analyzing how things work, then finding and fixing contradictions
INTP.work: A place where thinking itself is the job

ESTP.want: The thrill of moving and seeing results right away, and competing in the moment
ESTP.effort: Acting without hesitation and grabbing the chance in front of you
ESTP.work: Work where speed and action turn straight into results

ESFP.want: Sharing fun with people, and savoring the moment
ESFP.effort: Brightening the room and making everyone have a good time
ESFP.work: Work where you deal with people directly and see them smile

ENFP.want: Exciting possibilities, and the joy of connecting with people
ENFP.effort: Coming up with ideas and getting people on board to start something new
ENFP.work: Work full of new projects and new people

ENTP.want: The freedom to try new ideas, and smart debates
ENTP.effort: Questioning the usual and finding a breakthrough from another angle
ENTP.work: Work with lots of change, where ideas win

ESTJ.want: The satisfaction of organizing things and moving them forward, and a role with responsibility
ESTJ.effort: Setting up the plan, bringing people together, and getting results
ESTJ.work: Work where you run an organization and see results in numbers

ESFJ.want: A place where everyone gets along, and the joy of being thanked
ESFJ.effort: Connecting people and keeping things in harmony
ESFJ.work: Work where you engage with your team or community and can be the one who pulls it together

ENFJ.want: Bringing out people's potential, and relationships built on trust
ENFJ.effort: Encouraging people and uniting the team toward a goal
ENFJ.work: Work where you grow and guide people

ENTJ.want: Moving people and things toward a big goal, and the freedom to make the call
ENTJ.effort: Making decisions, moving people efficiently, and getting results
ENTJ.work: Work where you have decision-making power and can aim for big results

IE.worry: After seeing people, you crash even though it was fun. Free time makes you restless, so you fill even your days off.
IE.work: You may be praised for roles in front of people or for constant back-and-forth with others. But your true self shines in work that gives you time to focus alone.
IE.key: Once a week, book some time to talk to no one, and put it on your schedule first.

EI.worry: You somehow feel low and can't get motivated. You spend more and more time stuck in your own head.
EI.work: You may have gotten used to working quietly on your own. But your true self gets energy from being with people. A role with more chances to talk with others may bring your spark back.
EI.key: Make just one plan to see someone you get along with.

SN.worry: Ideas and plans for the future come easily, but you feel uneasy, as if your feet aren't on the ground.
SN.work: You may be handling roles that call for planning and big-picture ideas. But your true self is good at building on facts and steps. Work with concrete, visible results lets you give your best with peace of mind.
SN.key: Write down the plan in your head as one step you can take today.

NS.worry: Every day is the same routine, and it feels dull and stifling.
NS.work: You may be doing well in work that demands accuracy and procedure. But your true self thinks about "what comes next." You come alive when you get to work on new projects and ideas.
NS.key: Spend 10 minutes daydreaming a "what if" that has nothing to do with work.

TF.worry: After going along with others, you're left thinking, "What I really wanted to say was..." You're tired of not being able to make up your mind.
TF.work: People may rely on you for your thoughtfulness and for smoothing things over. But your true self makes decisions with clear logic. A position where you can decide based on reasons lets you work without second-guessing.
TF.key: For important things, write the pros and cons on paper before you decide.

FT.worry: The more rationally you act, the more you feel your heart is being left behind.
FT.work: You may be working in a way that's judged by numbers and efficiency. But your true self cares deeply about people's feelings. Work where you can feel you're helping someone fills your heart.
FT.key: Today, choose one thing by "Do I like it?" instead of "Is it right?"

JP.worry: You're free to move as you like, yet you always feel anxious and rushed because nothing is settled.
JP.work: You may have gotten used to a workplace that demands thinking on your feet. But your true self moves steadily with a clear outlook. Work where you can see what's coming lets you give your best with peace of mind.
JP.key: Set a rough plan for your week ahead of time.

PJ.worry: You get everything done properly, yet sometimes you want to throw it all away.
PJ.work: You may be trusted with planning and managing. But your true self adapts flexibly to the situation. Work with variety, where you decide how to proceed, lets you shine.
PJ.key: Put a day with no plans on your calendar first.

AT.worry: You really want to decide and move on your own, but worrying about how others see you freezes you. Even after deciding, you keep asking yourself, "Was that okay?"
AT.work: You may be valued for your carefulness in fitting in with others. But your true self moves forward on your own judgment. Work where you're given room to decide lets you give your best.
AT.key: Today, decide just one thing on your own without asking anyone.

TA.worry: Acting confident has become the norm, and now you can't tell anyone what really worries you.
TA.work: People may rely on you for being decisive and pushing things forward. But your true self watches carefully and moves with caution. Work where you can take time to prepare and check lets you give your best with peace of mind.
TA.key: Tell just one worry to someone you trust.

same.worry: Your true self and your current self match. If something is weighing on you, the cause may lie in your surroundings or relationships rather than your personality.
same.work: Your current way of working very likely suits your true self. When in doubt, it's okay to trust your own sense.
same.key: Write down just one moment when you feel "this isn't like me."

letter.E: Gets energy from being with people
letter.F: Decides by what feels right for people
letter.J: Moves ahead with a clear plan
letter.AT_A: Moves ahead trusting their own judgment
letter.AT_T: Watches carefully and moves with caution
